title: Normalized ringed slice comparison data
statement: Let J be a site small in the module universe, A a commutative ring sheaf and U an object. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], exact derived restriction r [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction], and the fixed K-injective Hom functors H and H_U [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Fix closed structures S,S_U and their normalized representative models T,T_U [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Slice comparison data consist of tensor isomorphisms rho:r(S(L,M))≅S_U(rL,rM), Hom isomorphisms eta:rH(L,M)≅H_U(rL,rM), both simultaneously natural in their two variables, natural symmetry families sigma and sigma_U, and preservation by restriction of K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex] with flat terms. Their normalization is the conjunction of four representative conditions: rho is localization of the total-complex comparison [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] which on each summand is the pure-tensor identity [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]; eta is the relocalization identity on local families of maps in the Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex], with the fixed K-injective augmentations; sigma and sigma_U are the Koszul exchanges x⊗y↦(-1)^(pq)y⊗x on total tensor models, compatible with localization. All squares use the exact restriction localization comparison. This defines the comparison data and their normalization, without asserting existence or the evaluation/transpose equations.

def RingedSliceEvaluationNormalized (U : C)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose (J.over U) (forget₂
      CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj (A.over U)))]
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A))
    (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, c, v, w} J A S)
    (SU : CoefficientClosedStructure
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)))
    (TU : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, max c v, v, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U) SU)
    (d : RingedSliceEvaluationComparisons (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A)
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U))
      (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U) S SU (RingedSliceFlatRestriction.{c, v,
      u} J A U)) : Prop
